dogecoin.text: In the beginning, these coins were built on a sense of fun and belonging. Dogecoin wasn’t just a coin with a Shiba Inu on it; it was about a bunch of people coming together, having a laugh, and watching something crazy grow out of nothing.

Meme coins like Dogecoin and Shiba Inu started as something special. They weren’t just about trading crypto — they were about the people. It was about the memes, the laughs, the shared jokes. It was a movement, not just a market. But now?
